c1_fact: Playwright exposes all three interfaces: (1) Programmatic API (TypeScript SDK with chromium module), (2) MCP server via npx @playwright/mcp@latest with structured accessibility snapshots, (3) CLI via @playwright/cli for agent-based browser control. All callable from TypeScript.
c2_fact: Designed for CI. GitHub Actions workflows use ubuntu-latest. Install: npm ci + npx playwright install --with-deps. Headless by default. No external infrastructure needed.
c4_fact: playwright-core package is small (browser automation primitives without browser binaries). Full playwright package downloads browsers on demand. Docker images available with pre-installed browsers. Setup time optimized for CI with npm ci + playwright install.
